detail.longDescription: Can games help people cope with ADHD? Are games naturally appealing to folks who have ADHD? How can we make excellent games for people with ADHD? I am on leave from a PhD program to medicate my newly diagnosed ADHD. The diagnosis also inspired my new topic in games research. I want to know everything about the relationship between ADHD and games. I want to use social media to spread anything I learn. Curious? Follow for novel research results on ADHD and video games. # adhd # research # indiedev
